description: This file implements a hash map based freelist management system for tracking free pages in a database, including initialization, allocation, freeing, merging, and internal consistency checks.

classes.name: hashMap
classes.description: A hash map structure managing free page spans, with methods for initialization, allocation, merging, and internal consistency.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the freelist with a sorted list of page IDs, creating spans of continuous pages.

methods.name: Allocate
methods.description: Allocates a span of free pages of specified size, returning the starting page ID.

methods.name: FreeCount
methods.description: Returns the count of free pages.

methods.name: freePageIds
methods.description: Returns a list of all free page IDs.

methods.name: hashmapFreeCountSlow
methods.description: Calculates free page count by summing sizes in forwardMap.

methods.name: addSpan
methods.description: Adds a span of free pages starting at a given page ID.

methods.name: delSpan
methods.description: Deletes a span of free pages starting at a given page ID.

methods.name: mergeSpans
methods.description: Merges multiple spans of free pages into larger spans.

methods.name: mergeWithExistingSpan
methods.description: Merges a page ID into existing free spans, attempting to merge backward and forward.

methods.name: idsFromFreemaps
methods.description: Retrieves all free page IDs from internal freemaps (used for testing).

methods.name: idsFromForwardMap
methods.description: Retrieves all free page IDs from the forward map (used for testing).

methods.name: idsFromBackwardMap
methods.description: Retrieves all free page IDs from the backward map (used for testing).
